title: Silique
summary: SIL'IQUA, SILIQUE noun [Latin siliqua.] A pod; an oblong, membranaceous, bivalvular pericarp, having the seeds fixed to both sutures.

inlines.v: SIL'IQUA, SILIQUE noun [Latin siliqua.] A pod; an oblong, membranaceous, bivalvular pericarp, having the seeds fixed to both sutures.
